text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I came to the cafeteria, two familiar faces
were sitting at a table with photos spread out, talking.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I see... I completely agree with the advice
Trainer gave you!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If it's a scrapbook to gift your master, it would be much better
to include photos beyond just your missions!♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Everyday scenes, school events...
There are—so many...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Are there any photos
that catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—... 
This. is the missing piece.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...The photo of our Droit, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That was such a wonderful time...
Even now, I often find myself reminiscing about it.

text_block_list.name: Excited Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Did you guys see Gimlet and Tap's dance?
With that, maybe the Best Date title is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Unshakable confidence,
believing in oneself... That is the source of strength.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: If I am to surpass it—then I, too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Capability, compatibility, perspective... In every aspect,
you are—my best answer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—The Best Date... mission.
—I want you to execute it with me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—...!!
Kris S-san—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...I am honored. I am certain that with you,
it would become a date that serves as a cornerstone for those who follow.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...However—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-san.
First, why don't we go on a date for the sake of dating?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Huh?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah... Kris S-san, do you also like
watching river water flow like this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—...Yeah. Listening to the sound...
I feel so calm—my heart... is at peace.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes... While we can experience natural sights
and sounds through TV or videos—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Hearing it directly from you like this resonates within me so much more deeply.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so you're fond of gentle animals, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Are you――not, as well?
You have been――smiling the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Animals are adorable, but I love seeing the joy on the faces of those watching them.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm having so much fun right now♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...I see.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, what a pity. It looks like it's almost time to head back.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...How did you enjoy our date today?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――How did I enjoy it... meaning?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Like what you felt, or how it compared to when you're alone――I just wanted to hear your honest thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――There was... a difference from the usual.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――The sharing... transmission of sensation――
――The cause... remains unknown.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
However――warmth.
I felt... warmth.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――When you said it was a 'pity'...
I realized... I felt the same.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪ So you had a wonderful time as well, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――...Yeah.
――Undoubtedly... I did.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Kris S-san, I hope the soirée will be just like today.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Taking each other's hands as partners, sharing the same moments, building up memories together――

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Winning Best Date is the highlight of the soirée, but just as importantly, I want you to truly enjoy the night, Kris S-san...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: And above all, I want to enjoy it with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Is that your Mission?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...No. It's simply my own terribly selfish wish♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――I see... Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――This scenery... this sensation.
――I could not have obtained it alone.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...I'm so glad.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Let us dance one more song.
...I want to etch even more memories between us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Memory――I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Daily memory is also... a piece.
The trajectory of... my growth.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――Cesario, ――I want this photograph.
――Are you alright with that?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Of course. Nothing would make me happier than for it to become one of your treasured memories, Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. This time――I should be able to create it.
The scrapbook――I truly desire.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It looks like Symboli Kris S's scrapbook project will turn out well――feeling a sense of relief wash over me, I smiled.
